moworks.notes: Target moves 0 → 1 on a damped spring, stiffness 180, damping 13, mass 0.6 (closed-form step response, damping ratio 0.63): 8.1 % overshoot, within 1 % by ~370 ms. Kit form: springk(300, 21.7) (k/m, c/m) over 0.37 s. Rule: UI presses, small accents, crisp. Small demo: the target moves 102 px beside the response graph, with overshoot and settle readouts. Params: stiffness (180) · damping (13) · mass (0.6) · duration (0.37 s). Damping ratio 0.63: about 8 % past, within 1 % by ~0.37 s. For presses and small accents.
